03a_1_metric_heat_map.png: The corrected metric $g_{\mu\nu}$ at the point $z = 6Hx_0 = \pi/4$ with $a_4 = 0.5$ and $b_4 = e^{2/3}$ (the deflating history at $a_4 = 0.5$, $b_4(0) = 1$), drawn as a heat map: row $\mu$ and column $\nu$ run over the coordinates $x_0$ to $x_7$, red squares are positive entries, blue squares negative ones, grey squares zero; the number in each square is the entry. Only the diagonal is non-zero; the hidden entry is $e^{-1}e^{2/3}\cot^2(\pi/4) = e^{-1/3} = 0.717$, the three 3-space entries are equal, $e^{1} = 2.718$, the three extra-time entries are equal, $-e^{-1/3}(\sin^2 \pi/4)^{1/6} = -0.638$, and the time entry is $-1$: four positive and four negative entries, the signature (4,4).
03a_2_diagonal_entries.png: The diagonal entries of the corrected metric as functions of $z = 6Hx_0$ from $-\pi$ to $\pi$ (two cells, each made of two halves joined at a fold), for $a_4 = 0.5$ and $b_4 = e^{2/3}$ (the deflating history at $a_4 = 0.5$); horizontal axis $z$ in radians, vertical axis the value of the entry (pure numbers). The three 3-space entries (solid red) are $e = 2.718$ at every $z$, the three extra-time entries (dashed blue) and the time entry (dash-dotted) stay negative everywhere, so the signature is (4,4) at every point with $\sin z\cos z \neq 0$; the hidden entry (aqua) grows without bound towards the tips $z = 0, \pm\pi$ and reaches $0$ at the folds $z = \pm\pi/2$ (grey vertical lines), where the determinant, drawn as $\cos^2 z/|\sin z|$ (dotted black), also vanishes.
03a_3_history_scale_factors.png: The time dependence of the scale factors along the deflating history $a_4 = A H x_4$, $b_4 = b_4(0)\,e^{\beta A H x_4}$ with $A = 1$, $H = 1$, $b_4(0) = 1$, $\beta = 4/3$ of the Revision Kohn-Sham work: 3-space $e^{a_4}$ (solid red), the common factor $f = e^{-a_4}b_4^{1/2} = e^{-a_4/3}$ of the hidden direction and the three extra times (dashed blue) and their product $e^{2a_4/3}$ (dotted black), on an ordinary (left) and a logarithmic (right) vertical axis; horizontal axis the time $x_4$ in units of $1/H$, vertical axis the factor by which lengths have grown since $x_4 = 0$ (a pure number). Dots and squares mark the five slices $a_4 = 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2$. 3-space grows by $e^2 = 7.39$ and the hidden direction and the extra times shrink to $e^{-2/3} = 0.513$; on the logarithmic axis both are straight lines with slopes $+1$ and $-1/3$, the product grows by $e^{4/3} = 3.79$.
03a_4_hidden_direction.png: The functions of the hidden coordinate $z = 6Hx_0$ in the corrected metric, across two cells $-\pi < z < \pi$; horizontal axes $z$ in radians, vertical axes pure numbers. Left: the warp factor $W = (\sin^2 z)^{1/12}$ of the three extra times (solid) and its square $W^2 = (\sin^2 z)^{1/6}$, which stands in the three extra-time metric entries (dashed), rise from $0$ at each tip to $1$ at each fold $z = \pm\pi/2$. Right, on a logarithmic axis: the factor $|\cot z|$ of the hidden direction (solid) and its square $\cot^2 z$ of $g_{00}$ (dashed) grow without bound towards each tip and fall to $0$ at each fold. All four repeat with the period $\pi$ and are symmetric about each fold.
03a_5_scale_factor_maps.png: Maps of the logarithm to base 10 of the scale factor of the hidden direction $e^{-a_4}b_4^{1/2}|\cot z| = e^{-a_4/3}|\cot z|$ (left) and of an extra time $e^{-a_4}b_4^{1/2}(\sin^2 z)^{1/12} = e^{-a_4/3}(\sin^2 z)^{1/12}$ (right) along the deflating history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$; horizontal axes the time $x_4$ in units of $1/H$, vertical axes $z = 6Hx_0$ in radians across one cell $0 < z < \pi$ (the dotted line is the fold $z = \pi/2$), colour the value (red above $0$: lengths larger than the coordinate interval, blue below $0$: smaller, grey and the black line: factor $1$). As time goes on both shrink at every $z$ (the black lines move towards the tips), the hidden factor vanishes at the fold, and both maps are symmetric about the fold.
03a_6_proper_volumes.png: Proper volumes per unit coordinate volume at the fixed hidden position $z = \pi/3$ along the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($f = e^{-a_4/3}$), on a logarithmic vertical axis; horizontal axis the time $x_4$ in units of $1/H$. The proper 3-volume of 3-space $V_3$ (solid red) grows like $e^{3x_4}$, the proper 3-volume of the three extra times $V_t$ (dashed blue) shrinks like $e^{-x_4}$, their product (dash-dotted, $0.931$ at $x_4 = 0$) grows like $e^{2x_4}$, and the density of the proper 7-volume (dotted, $0.537$ at $x_4 = 0$), which also contains the shrinking hidden factor, grows like $e^{5x_4/3}$.
03a_7_hidden_coordinate_y.png: The hidden coordinate $y = \ln|\sin z|/(6H)$ with $H = 1$. Left: $y$ versus $z = 6Hx_0$ in radians on a logarithmic axis from $10^{-10}$ to $\pi/2$ (the half cell next to the tip $z = 0$); $y$ is $0$ at the fold $z = \pi/2$ and falls without bound towards the tip $z \to 0$, along the straight line $y \approx \ln(z)/6$; the dashed line and the dot mark the tip cut-off $y = -3$ of the Revision Kohn-Sham solver, at $z = 1.5 \times 10^{-8}$. Right: the warp factor $W = e^{Hy}$ of the extra times (solid), its square $W^2 = e^{2Hy}$ (dash-dotted) and the density $e^{3Hy}$ of the proper 7-volume in the unit $e^{-a_4}b_4^2$ (dashed) versus $y$ in units of $1/H$; the grey band beyond the cut-off holds only the fraction $e^{-9} = 1.2 \times 10^{-4}$ of the 7-volume of the half cell.
